scope: first-slot plus collision-only remainder, independent timing source from caller-owned sink
order: empty table completes with the original zero slot and absent ID
first bucket is hash & (n-1), exactly the original offset zero
generation mismatch or full key equality completes in that bucket
only a same-generation different key enters remainingProbe
remaining offsets 1 through n-1 visit every remaining bucket once in the original masked order
a full-table miss restores the original zero slot
key_equality: full state, byteOffset, checkpoint and flags remain compared
Core_preconditions: fresh boundaryProbeForKey literal supplies zero slot/found; full lookup wrapper clears reused scratch before firstProbe
storage_and_lifetime: same index/slot/probe/journal types; caller scratch never retained and no callback or table mutation between checks
preserved_failure_and_mutation_order: Core frontier, predecessor, payload and stored-cost validations still precede probing; publish and rollback mechanics unchanged
